units: <cite ref="Taanit 24a:9">Taan. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>אתיא למִיפְתַּח … ולא מִיפְּתַח וכ׳</he> she came to open the door …, but it could not be opened on account of the wheat pressing against it.
<cite ref="Gittin 69b">Gitt. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>לִיפְתַּה הביתא וכ׳</he> let him open a keg of wine &c.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 112b:6">B. Kam. 112ᵇ</cite> <he>כגון דפָתְחוּ ליה בדיניה וכ׳</he> when they (the court) have opened his case (written a warrant, v. <cite ref="Q02161"><he>פְּתִיחָא</he> II</cite>) and sent for him.
<cite ref="Nedarim 28a:11">Ned. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>מיפתח הוא דלא יפתח וכ׳</he> he dare not offer to make oath (in order to escape robbery &c.), but make a vow, he may.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:18">Num. R. s. 9</cite> <he>תרעא דלא פתיח וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A02428"><he>אָסֵי</he></cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Nedarim 22a:4">Ned. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>אע״ג דפ׳ … אנן לא פַתְחִינָן וכ׳</he> although R. Y. offered such a suggestion for retracting a vow, we must not do so; <he>ולא פתחינן בהדא וכ׳</he> nor do we offer that other suggestion &c.; a. e.
senses.label: b

units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite>, beg. <he>א׳ ליה ביתיה וכ׳</he> he opened his house to him, and he entered.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 45:1">Targ. Is. XLV, 1</cite>.
Ib. XLII, 7.—Part. pass. מְפַתַּח open-eyed, able to see.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 22:5">Lev. R. s. 22</cite> <he>חד סמי וחד מפ׳</he> (<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 5:8:5">Koh. R. to V, 8</cite> <he>פתיח</he>) one was blind, and the other could see.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 3:5">Targ. O. Gen. III, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 3:7">7</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 12:14">Targ. Job XII, 14</cite>; a. fr.—
Gitt. 69ᵃ bot. לאִיפַּתּוּחֵי וכ׳ (Rashi לפתיחי, read: לפַתּוּחֵי Pa.) that the boil may open, let somebody blow &c.

Ib.ᵇ, v. צְפִירְתָּא; Pes. 42ᵇ; a. e.—Esp. to be restored to sight. Lev. R. l. c. דין דהוה סמי א׳ וכ׳ he who was blind recovered sight &c., v. סְמֵי; Koh. R. l. c. Ib. אִיתְפַּתְּחַת the she-ass recovered &c.; a. e.
